responsibility: Implements a terminal-backed channel device for the generic gm2 ISO I/O framework. It allocates a device id, stores per-channel terminal state including file descriptor, one-character pushback, and saved termios settings via RTdata, maps terminal reads/writes and look/skip operations through RTgen and RTgenif hooks, opens /dev/tty with flag-derived raw/text and echo mode configuration, restores terminal attributes on close, and translates OS errno conditions into the standard channel open and device error model.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file implements the terminal device opened through TermFile: unlike the same-stem .def specification, it allocates a device id, manages per-channel terminal state and termios settings, opens /dev/tty, and hooks the channel into the generic RTgen/IO device framework.
